objective: Recompute the frozen 450-cell H/S/B campaign under the manuscript's theorem-aligned frozen-reservoir with-replacement sampling branch.
provenance_amendment: The v1 process terminated before writing any primary result file. Version 2 added pre-result SHA-256 pins for all 450 raw NPZ files and all 450 TERMINAL sidecars, then terminated at the first PathMNIST cell because its semantic ID uses split_00 rather than split00; it also wrote no primary result file. Version 3 changes only that metadata parser and adds both identifier formats to the self-test. No estimand, seed, selector, sampling law, confidence allocation, or reporting rule changed.

frozen_selector_contract.candidate_selection: maximum positive certified coverage LCB; ties by smaller gamma, lexicographic theorem-facing score name, then candidate index

target_population.name: clientwise frozen certification-fold empirical reservoir conditional
target_population.within_client_distribution: uniform over the fixed certification records

primary_sampling_law.within_client_draw_size: n_draw_j = N_reservoir_j, equal to the archived certification count for that client
primary_sampling_law.law: I_jl iid Uniform({0,...,N_reservoir_j-1}) independently within every declared client
primary_sampling_law.duplicate_indices: retained with multiplicity and never interpreted as additional source-level labels
primary_sampling_law.common_random_numbers: the same realized client index vector is used for all 12 selectors and all H/S/B procedures
primary_sampling_law.officehome_seed_resolution: The frozen Confirmatory-400R matrix seed governs this paired headline recalculation. The different artifact-embedded audit_draw_seed belongs to the earlier standalone Office-Home analysis and is archived only as provenance.

H.risk: p_m = max_j BinomCDF(K_mj; A_mj, alpha), followed by Holm over M at delta_r

B.role: deliberately conservative clientwise Bonferroni confidence-allocation ablation

estimands.certification_rate: certified cells / all declared cells in the reported denominator
estimands.EffectiveCertCov: mean of certified coverage LCB with zero assigned to an uncertified cell
estimands.CondCertCov: mean coverage LCB among certified cells, reported with the certified denominator
estimands.cell_variation_interval: 20,000-replicate paired hierarchical bootstrap over split then training repetition, seed 20260825

fail_closed_validation: exactly 450 unique semantic IDs must be present
every declared NPZ and TERMINAL sidecar must match its pre-result byte count and SHA-256 pin
raw-input, family, archived-count, and seed maps must reject duplicate keys and exactly match the declared roster
certification source IDs must be unique within every cell
every declared client must have a nonempty reservoir
the record-level reconstruction must exactly reproduce all archived as-is A/K/n rows for six alpha values
every primary draw must satisfy 0 <= K <= A <= n
H, S, and B must consume an identical count-tensor hash in each cell and alpha
candidatewise S risk UCB cannot exceed B and S coverage LCB cannot fall below B
every B-certified cell must also be S-certified
any failed invariant aborts the run before a headline is accepted

output_policy.raw_primary_index_vectors: not released; per-client sequence SHA-256, uniqueness count, duplication rate, and maximum multiplicity are released
